points.place: 诺曼底地区博蒙昂诺曼底
points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 拉普拉斯出生于诺曼底地区的一个小康家庭，父亲是当地的小麦商人。他在家乡接受了基础教育，展现出非凡的数学天赋。16岁时，他离开家乡前往卡昂大学学习神学，但很快转向了对数学和物理学的热情。这段早期教育为他后来的科学事业奠定了坚实基础，培养了他对自然现象的数学化思考能力。
points.descriptionEn: Born into a moderately prosperous family in Normandy where his father was a local wheat merchant, Laplace received his basic education in his hometown, showing exceptional mathematical talent. At 16, he left home for Caen University to study theology but quickly developed a passion for mathematics and physics. This early education laid a solid foundation for his later scientific career, cultivating his ability to think mathematically about natural phenomena.

points.title: 巴黎求学
points.description: 拉普拉斯前往巴黎，在军事学院学习并开始接触当时最前沿的数学和物理学研究。他通过阅读欧拉、达朗贝尔等大师的著作自学成才，并很快在学术界崭露头角。1769年，他凭借一篇关于力学问题的论文引起了达朗贝尔的注意，后者推荐他到巴黎军事学院任教。这一时期，他开始系统研究天体力学，为日后的事业奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Laplace moved to Paris to study at the military academy and began engaging with the most advanced mathematics and physics research of the time. He was largely self-taught, studying the works of masters like Euler and d'Alembert, and quickly distinguished himself in academic circles. In 1769, his paper on mechanical problems caught d'Alembert's attention, who recommended him for a teaching position at the Paris Military Academy. During this period, he began systematically studying celestial mechanics, laying the foundation for his future career.

points.title: 学术奠基
points.description: 在巴黎军事学院任教期间，拉普拉斯完成了他最重要的早期工作，包括发展概率论和天体力学的基本理论。他提出了拉普拉斯变换，为解决微分方程提供了新方法；在概率论方面，他引入了贝叶斯定理的早期形式。1773年，他成为法国科学院院士，并开始系统研究太阳系的稳定性问题。这一时期，他发表了多篇重要论文，奠定了他在科学界的地位。
points.descriptionEn: While teaching at the Paris Military Academy, Laplace completed his most important early work, including developing fundamental theories of probability and celestial mechanics. He introduced the Laplace transform, providing new methods for solving differential equations; in probability theory, he introduced an early form of Bayes' theorem. In 1773, he became a member of the French Academy of Sciences and began systematically studying the stability of the solar system. During this period, he published numerous important papers, establishing his position in the scientific community.

points.title: 巅峰成就
points.description: 这一时期是拉普拉斯学术生涯的巅峰。他完成了五卷巨著《天体力学》，全面总结了牛顿以来的天体力学成就，并发展了更精确的数学方法来描述天体运动。1785年，他提出了著名的拉普拉斯妖思想实验，探讨了决定论与概率的关系。法国大革命期间，他虽然一度失去职位，但后来得到拿破仑的赏识，曾担任内政部长，并获封伯爵。1806年，他被选为法兰西学院院士，成为法国科学界的领袖人物。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked the peak of Laplace's academic career. He completed his monumental five-volume work 'Mécanique Céleste,' comprehensively summarizing the achievements of celestial mechanics since Newton and developing more precise mathematical methods to describe celestial motion. In 1785, he proposed the famous thought experiment of 'Laplace's demon,' exploring the relationship between determinism and probability. During the French Revolution, he temporarily lost his position but later gained Napoleon's favor, serving as Minister of the Interior and being made a count. In 1806, he was elected to the French Academy of Sciences, becoming a leading figure in French science.

points.title: 晚年贡献
points.description: 拉普拉斯晚年继续科学研究，同时致力于科学教育和普及。1816年，他成为法兰西学院院长，致力于推动科学教育改革。他出版了《概率论哲学》，系统阐述了概率论在科学和社会中的应用。1825年，他完成了《概率论的解析理论》，进一步完善了概率论体系。拉普拉斯晚年还参与了法国度量衡标准的制定工作，为科学标准化做出贡献。1827年，他在巴黎逝世，被安葬在巴黎先贤祠，成为少数几位因科学成就而非政治功绩获此殊荣的科学家。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Laplace continued his scientific research while dedicating himself to science education and popularization. In 1816, he became President of the French Academy, working to promote science education reform. He published 'Philosophical Essay on Probabilities,' systematically explaining the application of probability theory in science and society. In 1825, he completed 'Théorie analytique des probabilités,' further perfecting the probability theory system. In his later years, Laplace also participated in the development of French measurement standards, contributing to scientific standardization. He died in Paris in 1827 and was buried in the Panthéon, becoming one of the few scientists honored there for scientific achievements rather than political merits.

appraisal.zh: 拉普拉斯通常被视为连接牛顿力学与现代科学的关键人物，《天体力学》系统化了牛顿力学，概率论的开创性工作为现代统计学奠基，拉普拉斯变换则成为解微分方程的重要工具。不过也有研究者指出，他的决定论宇宙观过于机械，忽视了偶然性，与量子力学的不确定性原理直接冲突；其政治立场从君主制到革命再到拿破仑的摇摆，以及较少提及贝叶斯等人工作的做法，也常受诟病。
appraisal.en: Laplace is generally seen as a pivotal figure linking Newtonian mechanics to modern science: his 'Mécanique Céleste' systematized Newtonian mechanics, his pioneering probability work laid foundations for modern statistics, and the Laplace transform became an essential tool for differential equations. Yet researchers also note that his deterministic vision of the universe was overly mechanical, neglecting contingency and clashing directly with quantum uncertainty; his shifting political allegiances and his scant acknowledgment of predecessors such as Bayes are likewise faulted.

supporter.zh: 拉普拉斯被誉为法国科学界的巨人，是18-19世纪最具影响力的数学家和物理学家之一。他的《天体力学》系统化了牛顿力学，为天体运动提供了精确的数学描述；他在概率论方面的开创性工作为现代统计学奠定了基础；他提出的拉普拉斯变换成为解决微分方程的重要工具。拉普拉斯的科学精神体现了理性主义和决定论的完美结合，他的工作不仅推动了科学进步，也为人类理解宇宙提供了新的视角。
supporter.en: Laplace is celebrated as a giant of French science, one of the most influential mathematicians and physicists of the 18th-19th centuries. His 'Mécanique Céleste' systematized Newtonian mechanics, providing precise mathematical descriptions of celestial motion; his pioneering work in probability theory laid the foundation for modern statistics; the Laplace transform he introduced became an essential tool for solving differential equations. Laplace's scientific spirit embodies the perfect combination of rationalism and determinism, and his work not only advanced science but also provided new perspectives for humanity's understanding of the universe.

critic.zh: 批评者指出拉普拉斯的科学观过于机械和决定论，忽视了偶然性和量子现象的重要性。他在政治上的立场摇摆不定，从支持君主制到拥护革命再到效忠拿破仑，被批评为缺乏政治原则。此外，拉普拉斯有时未能充分承认前人的贡献，例如在概率论方面，他很少提及贝叶斯的工作。他的决定论观点也受到现代物理学和哲学的挑战，特别是量子力学的不确定性原理与他的宇宙完全可预测的观点直接冲突。
critic.en: Critics point out that Laplace's scientific view was overly mechanical and deterministic, neglecting the importance of contingency and quantum phenomena. His political stance was inconsistent, shifting from supporting monarchy to embracing revolution to serving Napoleon, which has been criticized as lacking political principles. Additionally, Laplace sometimes failed to adequately acknowledge the contributions of predecessors, rarely mentioning Bayes' work in probability theory. His deterministic views have been challenged by modern physics and philosophy, particularly as quantum mechanics' uncertainty principle directly conflicts with his view of a completely predictable universe.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，拉普拉斯被视为科学史上的关键人物，他的工作连接了牛顿经典力学与现代科学。流行文化中，他常被描绘为理性主义的象征，尤其是'拉普拉斯妖'思想实验成为讨论决定论与自由意志的经典案例。拉普拉斯的一生反映了启蒙运动时期科学家的典型特征：既追求纯粹知识，又积极参与公共事务。他的科学成就与政治生涯的交织，展现了科学与权力之间复杂的关系，使他成为研究科学社会学的重要案例。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Laplace is regarded as a pivotal figure in the history of science, whose work connected Newtonian classical mechanics with modern science. In popular culture, he is often depicted as a symbol of rationalism, with his 'Laplace's demon' thought experiment becoming a classic case study in discussions of determinism versus free will. Laplace's life reflects the typical characteristics of Enlightenment-era scientists: pursuing pure knowledge while actively engaging in public affairs. The interplay between his scientific achievements and political career illustrates the complex relationship between science and power, making him an important case study in the sociology of science.

self.zh: 我们应当把宇宙的现状视为它过去的结果和未来的原因。
self.en: We ought to regard the present state of the universe as the effect of its past and the cause of its future.
